content:
jamie: T-minus 60m checklist for the midnight change window — quick confirmations please. Freeze starts in 45m. Pin list and rollback trigger thresholds below.
jamie: TL;DR: pin v3.4.2 for prod routes, canary on 10%, watch latency and 5xxs, rollback if 5xx > 0.5% sustained for 2m or p95 latency > 1200ms.
dev-deploy-bot: Deploy pipeline preflight OK. Canaries canary-group-7 assigned. Pin applied to routes: api-llm, embeddings. Logs stream: https://logs.redwood.example/canary/4955551234 :white_check_mark:
nina: I'm on metrics (dashboards up). I'll call it if errors or latency move. Will monitor p95, p99, and token cost spike. @liam you'll have runbook? :eyes:
liam: oncall ready. my rollback command is below, keep it handy. If threshold hit, I'll run it and announce.
liam: ```
# rollback to pinned stable
redwood deploy rollback --service api-llm --to-version v3.4.1 --reason "auto-rollback: 5xx spike"
```
sasha: Release notes and changelog: https://confluence.redwood/example/release/v3.4.2 — includes KV cache tweak and quant kernel change. Noted potential warmup latency first 5m.
ops-oncall: Ops thresholds: set alert for 5xx >= 0.5% over 2m, p95 >= 1200ms over 3m, and error-rate delta +0.2% vs baseline. Pager escalates to ENG-SRE and APPS.
nina: Quick note — embeddings route will be rate-limited during warmup to 30rps until cache warms. I'll adjust dashboards to show request shaping.
jamie: Can somebody confirm deploy window exemptions? We're not allowing hotfixes unless critical. Any PM exceptions?
sasha: PM signoff already — exceptions require director + eng-lead ok. No exceptions on this window.
dev-deploy-bot: Canary progression: 10% -> stable check in 10m if metrics green. Current canary: 10% traffic, no 5xx in first 90s.
liam: I deployed the observer agent to canary nodes, tailing logs. If we see KV cache miss storm, I'll throttle and then rollback.
ops-oncall: Pro-tip: set instance scaling to aggressive-min to avoid cold-start spike. I've pushed the autoscaler tweak (auto-scaling-id: as-907).
jamie: final asks before freeze: - confirm pin is applied (dev-deploy-bot confirmed) - monitoring owners (nina, liam) - rollback cmd ready (liam confirmed) - release notes link shared (sasha confirmed)
jamie: thumbs if ready :thumbsup:
nina: :thumbsup: ready
liam: :thumbsup:
sasha: :thumbsup:
ops-oncall: :thumbsup:
dev-deploy-bot: Canary health OK. Proceeding to hold state. Use this thread for hot comms during the window.
jamie: Nice. We'll post an update at T-minus 15m and at canary -> 100% cutover. Keep comms short in this channel.
liam: I'll drop the rollback notice here if I run it. If anyone hears silence, assume normal progression.
jamie: Thanks everyone — moving to freeze in 45m. If you need to request an exemption, ping me + eng-lead in #urgent.
dev-deploy-bot: Incident heartbeat scheduled. Next automated check in 5m.
